title: Troubleshoot Wi-Fi connection drops
text: Restart the router, forget and reconnect to the wireless network, update the network adapter driver, and test near the access point. If only one device fails, reset that device's network settings.

title: Reset a forgotten account password
text: Select Forgot password on the sign-in page. Use the verification link sent to the recovery email, then choose a unique password. Contact an administrator if the recovery address is unavailable.

title: Resolve laptop battery drain
text: Check battery health, install firmware updates, reduce display brightness, and identify high-usage background applications. Replace the battery when full-charge capacity is below 60 percent.

title: VPN connects but internal sites do not load
text: Confirm DNS servers were assigned by the VPN, flush the DNS cache, and disable conflicting proxy settings. Verify split-tunnel routes and reconnect the VPN client.

title: Clear a stuck print queue
text: Cancel pending jobs, restart the print spooler service, and remove stale spool files. Reinstall the printer if jobs continue to remain queued.

title: Fix multi-factor authentication codes
text: Synchronize the phone clock, verify the enrolled authenticator account, and use a backup code. An administrator can reset MFA enrollment after identity verification.

title: Recover files from cloud version history
text: Open the document details, choose Version history, select a timestamp before the unwanted edit, and restore or download that version. Deleted files may remain in trash for 30 days.

title: Application crashes during startup
text: Install the latest application patch, remove corrupted cache files, verify available disk space, and start with extensions disabled. Collect crash logs before reinstalling.

title: Video meeting has echo or feedback
text: Use headphones, mute duplicate devices, reduce speaker volume, and ensure only one meeting client is active in the room. Run the audio device test before rejoining.

title: Email messages are delayed
text: Check service status, mailbox quota, inbox rules, and outbound attachment size. Inspect message trace and spam quarantine when delivery remains delayed.
